component.name: Navigator
component.summary: Fast keyboard-driven file manager for Linux
Linux için hızlı, klavye odaklı dosya yöneticisi

description.p: Navigator is a fast, keyboard-first file manager for Linux built with C++20/23 and SDL3. It features split panes, tabs, virtualized Details/Icons/List/Tree/Miller Columns views, instant name filtering, cancellable content search, batch rename, XDG Trash, archive browsing, GVfs mounts, Git status badges, and a C ABI plugin system.
Initial 0.1.0 release with .deb packaging, full keyboard-driven browser, preview inspector, file operations, and Linux extras.
